name: Payfoni SanalPos Entegrasyonu
author: Payfoni Entegrasyon

sections.description:
Payfoni SanalPos Entegrasyonu connects WooCommerce checkout to the Payfoni hosted payment page. Card details are entered on Payfoni, not on the store.

Setup:

  1. Open WooCommerce, then Settings, then Payments, then Payfoni.
  2. Enter the API / panel URL, API key, and API secret from your Payfoni account.
  3. In the Payfoni panel, enable iframe payments and add your store origin to the allow list.

Checkout flow: the customer places an order, the plugin opens a payment session, the payment form loads in an iframe, and the plugin confirms the result with the Payfoni status API before completing the order. Refunds can be sent from WooCommerce to Payfoni.

A Payfoni merchant account is required. Service terms: https://payfoni.com.tr / destek@payfoni.com.tr
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the zip from the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin. WooCommerce must already be active.
  3. Configure Payfoni under WooCommerce, Settings, Payments.
